title: Obstruct a hard source-call cap even with unlimited target calls
statement: If a universally exact algorithm has at most k fresh P calls on EVERY run, pad unused P-stream slots analytically to obtain n=m+k actual IID P observations. Conditional on their histogram A, the whole ordering is uniform independent of numerical P; the degree-n Bernstein identity again forces law(Y|A)=Q^m despite unlimited adaptive Q calls. Every actual original coordinate has conditional law A/n, so its mismatch>=TV(A/n,Q). At P=Q uniform, eta must be >=phi(d,n)=d E|Bin(n,1/d)-n/d|/(2n), of order min{1,sqrt(d/n)}. Thus m+k=Omega(d/eta^2). Padding is a proof device, not free acquired data. This is ONLY a deterministic P-query-cap bound, not E N_P=Omega(d/eta^2-m); unbounded rare paths can beat that expectation claim.

assumptions: Full all-regime expected-query minimax and any new matching attaining algorithm remain OPEN. The P-free theorem is an exactness-only pointwise optimum; below eta<delta(d,m), it shows no such P-free algorithm satisfies the original retention contract. It is NOT a general lower bound on expected P calls. P-only-cap obstruction applies to a HARD per-execution P cap while Q is unrestricted; no cap-to-expectation or moment transfer is made. Critical-batch theorem is conditional on the unconstructed computably uniform exact M-coupler. Shared-H rigidity requires H independent of actual old rows and conditionally IID output; it does not exclude joint dependent corrections. Adaptive stopping counterexample covers its stated naive two-stage archive only, not every adaptive archive. Imported Bernstein/fixed-histogram/categorical machinery counted once. Extra High verified at post/recoveries, throughout/helper compute unknown; activity/site counts are not compute/proof validation. No ZIP identified or extra source acquisition/recovery. All known/unknown resource/source/access/transfer holds and native-model unverified status persist.
costs: Original m acquisition/storage remains charged in end-to-end comparisons. Unlimited Q stopping is explicitly allowed in P-free/P-cap lower bounds. Padding unused P slots is an analytical proof device, not uncharged algorithmic input. Critical M=ceil(d/eta) reduction pays M-m extra P draws for a short batch or only its final short block, fresh independent block computations, explicit permutations/inverse permutations and output. Given a computably uniform critical coupler of expected work W(d,M,eta), J=ceil(m/M) calls pay J copies of that work plus finite integer/permutation/input/output overhead and at most M padding calls; its source bill is O(m+M). A positive critical-batch coupler and its W are NOT constructed. Deterministic cap m+k=Omega(d/eta^2) does not imply the same expected-N_P lower bound; rare long paths are admitted. Source analytic counterexample not re-enumerated/executed by Capital; no physical oracle implementation cost is invented.
contract.units: ENTIRE exact product law, same-original-row expected mismatch/TV, new P/Q oracle calls, hard per-run source cap versus expected stopping, paid integer/permutation/local-work/output costs.
obstruction: Construct an exact critical-batch O(d/eta) coupler with paid computational uniformity, or a stronger expected-query lower bound refuting that candidate rate. Neither follows from the P-free/P-cap barriers or the invalid adaptive shortcut.
